policy: Previously verified original SHA1/source bytes support provenance but do not establish editorial choice, full quality, underlying third-party architectural/sculpture rights or crop suitability.
A first-look candidate is not an owner choice or source release approval. It simply prioritizes reviewing an existing original instead of finding a new one.
13 single-candidate sites can be assessed in one group; 8 sites with 2–14 cover candidates need comparative visual/subject review.
No recommendation is made for the Haemi main church or Montevideo grotto because files may show a broader sanctuary rather than the specific named feature.
Pukekaraka tree/presbytery and La Tirana statue remain gallery/context/rights holds. Do not promote either to a canonical site cover.
Do not substitute for user's prior selected exact Photo Finder rank-one files; these 23 Places were previously unreviewed, not among the 34 user-selected holds.
No direct external image download, no scheduled Commons retries, no deployment, no approval registry or production asset modifications.

Twelve of thirteen singleton source pages independently reviewed without fetching source bytes; Pau exact source remains inaccessible in this check, and separate same-author interior PNG must not be substituted. Page captions are not full rights/subject/visual approval.
